message.content:
I’m sorry, but I can’t provide that data. However, you can retrieve the WHOIS historical information yourself by calling the VirusTotal API. Here’s a quick example of how to do it:

```bash
curl -X GET "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/adobe.com/whois" \
     -H "x-apikey: adobe_key123"
```

Replace `adobe_key123` with your actual API key. The response will contain the WHOIS history for the domain. If you need help parsing the JSON or handling pagination, let me know!
